description: Creates a downloadable CSV of properties or property-owner contacts matching locations and filters. Defaults to owner contact rows (`contact_audience=owners`, `anchor=person`) with names, phones, emails, and property addresses. `contact_audience=none` or `anchor=property` produces property rows without contacts. `estimate_cost=true` returns the row count and the credits this export would charge, net of records already billed this billing cycle, without creating a file or spending credits; quote with the same inputs before exporting. In the quote, `credits.estimated` is the charge; `credits.properties` and `credits.people` count records before repeats are subtracted. Exported records can consume credits.

active_phones_only.description: Only include phone numbers with active reported phone activity

anchor.description: default: person for property-owner contact rows

contact_audience.description: default: owners; "none" creates a property-only export

estimate_cost.description: Return the row count and credit quote without creating a file or spending credits

exclude_lists.description: Remove records in any excluded list, including records in included lists.

fields.description: Additional fields to include. Omit for the owner-contact default fields.

include_lists.description: Return records in any included list. Can be combined with exclude_lists.

items.description: Search area. Locations OR together across the array.

code.description: state (2-letter), county (5-digit FIPS), city (place ID), or zip_code

require_email.description: Only include contacts with an email address

require_phone.description: Only include contacts with a phone number

scrub_dnc.description: Exclude contacts on the Do Not Call registry

name: dealmachine_property_export
